market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at $77,600-78,600. To dip to $55,000 requires ~30% drop. Such drawdowns are common in BTC over an 8-month window historically (post-2020 cycles typically see ~20-30% corrections). Given choppy consolidation and macro overhangs, ~25-30% feels right.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a sustained correction materializes vs. range-bound chop
